decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork product with a dedicated web presence after only one year, it is a low-risk option whose market potential is still too uncertain to abandon.
This automation-related product builds directly on the firm's core systems strategy, so keeping it preserves an important growth option while learning about demand.
Although only briefly presented, this adjacent component likely costs little to carry alongside the existing offer, so the firm would keep the option open until clearer market feedback emerges.
A dedicated page suggests meaningful initial commitment, and as a close fit with the firm's modular formwork business it should be retained while uncertainty is still resolving.
Because it is closely related to the established offer and likely inexpensive to maintain within the product portfolio, there is little reason to abandon it after such a short market test.
Even with limited promotion, this near-core magnetic component extends the firm's solution set and can be kept as a relatively low-cost option pending more evidence.
